title: AI Agents Are Testing the Limits of Zero-Trust Security
summary: This article is brought to you by Queen’s University Belfast. Several teams around the globe are leveraging AI by creating a task force of agents managed by an orchestrator and creating applications to support risk assessment, client profiling, match making, and information yield
